key_decisions.decision: Preserves invasion after faithfulness rather than implying prior wrongdoing caused it.
Preserves difficult tower construction phrasing and all defensive works.
Preserves open more-with-us comparison rather than supplying unseen troops.
Retains arm-of-flesh and leaning images with brief vocabulary explanation.
Keeps destruction language and repeated hand/rescue challenge.
Keeps three victim groups and offspring, without importing Kings' numbers or sons' names.
Retains guided rather than replacing the Hebrew with gave-rest alternative.
Renders difficult final livestock phrase contextually while retaining all agricultural categories.
Retains cities as pinned rather than substituting flocks or enclosures.
Preserves divine leaving and knowing-purpose without theological mitigation.
Retains ascent's spatial ambiguity and public honor rather than ordinary tomb formula.
